VIDEO INTRODUCTION:
Ladies and gentlemen,
A new protest has erupted in India, and this time, it is questioning the backbone of Indian democracy. Protestors are demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar himself!!
But the loudest warnings are not coming from outside. They are coming from inside the Election Commission itself!! An Indian Express investigation states that 2 out of 3 Election Commissioners have objected at least 14 times in 10 months, saying some decisions were taken without their knowledge!!
